title: Isandro and the Hollow
author: Zephyrine Nakamura
blurb: Hazel Sandoval, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
